item.title: Candy prices got you scared stiff? What to know about the cost of Halloween this year
item.description: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year and are up more than 18% in two years, according to the latest federal data.

item.title: Thomas Mann returns to his 'Fatherland' in this practically flawless film
item.description: Fatherland imagines the Nobel Prize-winning author's 1949 return to Germany after years of exile. Just 82 minutes long, this gorgeous film is meticulously staged and shot in black and white.

item.title: New book revisits the 2023 killing of an unhoused man in crisis on the NYC subway
item.description: Jordan Neely was frightening fellow passengers. A former Marine named Daniel Penny put Neely into a chokehold, killing him. Journalist Anand Giridharadas investigates the incident in Man in the Mirror.
